value.rationale: The IDP Ehrhart h-star log-concavity problem is substantial and recent. The result determines an exact two-variable phase region for canonical smooth six-dimensional Cayley boxes, establishes a sharp asymptotic window with two distinct scales, and exhibits infinitely many examples with a sharp integer threshold. It is neither a mere recomputation of the known high-dimensional example nor an unmotivated coefficient check; independent validation remains unperformed.
